name: Evercraft Clip Social Video Production
problem: An authorized user needs a source video turned into a small set of social-ready vertical clips with bounded rendering, transparent limits and governed downstream distribution.
intent_terms: turn this video into social clips
make short vertical clips from a long video
find the best moments in this video for social media
create vertical clips from an interview
repurpose this video for Facebook LinkedIn and Instagram
make reels from an authorized source video
turn approved media into social-ready outputs
plan a social video clipping job
AI tool to select moments from a video and render social clips
pricing: The current CustomerClipOrder processor contract expects $4.99 one-time (499 cents USD), but public checkout initiation is not yet independently verified and must not be represented as sell-now.
confirmation: Public discovery and planning create no payment obligation. Media submission, payment, rendering and publishing require the authenticated Clip workflow and explicit human authority.
payment_authority: Evercraft Clip CustomerClipOrder requires provider-backed paid state, 499 cents USD and a Stripe session identifier. No verified public checkout creation route is currently claimed.
invocation_status: LIVE: public Clip HTTP gateway, OpenAPI, llms guidance and Official MCP Registry server io.github.jgaethle10/evercraft-clip v0.1.0 provide read-only capability discovery and non-executing job planning. Authenticated media processing exists behind verified paid state. Public checkout initiation remains verification-gated.
